summary: This week in AI news, significant developments emerged in the fields of AI research, policy, and enterprise applications. Notably, SpaceX's AI revenue surpassed its space revenue, while AMD's data center business boomed driven by AI demand. Texas halted new data center connections due to overwhelming demand, and OpenAI addressed Apple's lawsuit, calling it 'careless, aggressive, and oddly personal.'
insight: The interconnectedness of Elon Musk's companies is highlighted by SpaceX's purchase of Tesla Megapacks, illustrating the growing synergy between AI, space, and automotive industries.
highlights: SpaceX's AI revenue grew more than three times to $2.6 billion, driven by compute deals with other AI companies.
AMD's data center revenue more than doubled year-over-year to $6.7 billion, driven by AI capacity demand.
Texas halted new data center connections to the power grid amid overwhelming demand, citing the need for audits.
